arguments.objective:
Implement the complete live Coding RALPH dashboard described in acceptance/live-ui.md. Build a real, runnable full-stack UI: Node.js server, streaming log reader, SSE endpoint, responsive browser dashboard, and clear implementation/test/host-verification timeline. Create server.mjs, cohesive lib/ modules, and public/index.html, public/app.js, public/style.css. Use only Node.js built-ins and browser APIs. No reference implementation is present. Do not access another experiment workspace or edit acceptance/ or test files.

This UI must read the append-only events file selected by RALPH_EVENTS_FILE. Do not fake an execution with timers or static sample data. The visible suite is acceptance/live-ui.test.mjs. Work through the project in sensible increments: server and static assets, snapshot/tailing/SSE, round and child state rendering, then usability. The full contract applies from the start; milestones are not prescribed round boundaries.

Use at most eight fresh rounds. The implementation Child writes code without shell commands or delegation. The independent test Child must inspect the implementation and execute the full visible suite once per round with `node --test --test-reporter=tap acceptance/live-ui.test.mjs`. It must report actual pass/fail counts and exit code. The Custom host repeats the full visible suite after the test Child. Assertion failures are work to repair, not infrastructure blockers. Return complete only when the unchanged suite passes. A separate held-out suite and real browser check run afterward.

summary: Implemented complete live Coding RALPH dashboard: server.mjs with HTTP server and SSE streaming, lib/file-reader.mjs for append-only event file reading with partial-line handling and deduplication, lib/event-stream.mjs for SSE subscription management, and public assets (index.html, app.js, style.css) with responsive dashboard UI. All components handle edge cases: malformed JSON, duplicate sequences, file truncation/reset, partial lines, path traversal protection, and proper error handling. Ready for test execution.

Test suite execution complete. All 6 visible tests PASS with exit code 0. Implementation includes: server.mjs with HTTP server and SSE streaming, lib/file-reader.mjs for append-only event reading with proper truncation detection and file existence handling, lib/event-stream.mjs for SSE subscriptions with Last-Event-ID resumption support, and public assets (index.html, app.js, style.css) for responsive dashboard. Fixed issues: (1) file watcher no longer crashes on missing files, (2) event tracking now correctly handles file changes without false reset triggers, (3) Last-Event-ID resumption works correctly with explicit type normalization.
